evidence_quotes: Residencia inserida em Area de preservacao permanente, as margens do Corrego de Cubas, porem em meio urbano.
No caso presente, o TJ entende que as matas ciliares visam à preservação dos recursos hídricos e, de modo secundário, as demais funções.
rationale: The TJSP decision substantively adjudicates municipal environmental liability concerning a residence built within the 30-meter riparian Permanent Preservation Area (APP / mata ciliar) along the Córrego de Cubas in Guarulhos, examining watershed environmental quality (Bacia dos Cubas), stream channelization with gabions, the municipal drainage master plan, and the ecological function of riparian buffers in preserving water resources. Under the 21-category codebook, mata ciliar / APP environmental enforcement maps directly to environmental_protection, with no household water/sanitation connection dispute or informal-settlement service access claim.
